stories.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to review, fix and approve code
body: Claude Ship is a suite of AI agents that review code changes and fix problems.
One agent can approve routine changes automatically, based on rules a team sets.
It targets the review bottleneck as AI writes more code.
stories.vc: Faster code shipping could cut software development costs.

stories.headline: Why Oliver Bearman's 2027 Haas deal is still unsigned
body: Bearman has ruled out racing elsewhere in 2027 and Haas wants to keep him.
Autosport says talks have stalled over the financial terms with Haas.
Ferrari has already exercised its option to keep him in its driver programme.
stories.joke: Contract: agreed in spirit, not in ink.
stories.vc: Driver deals are also money deals between teams.
